breadth_200dma.description: Share of the tradable ETF universe above its own 200-day moving average, decimal 0-1.
breadth_200dma.source_note: Computed from local QQQ/GLD/SGOV daily price history available at the monthly decision date.

tbill_3m_rate.description: 3-month Treasury bill secondary market discount rate as a decimal.
tbill_3m_rate.source_note: Pulled from FRED DTB3 and converted from percent to decimal.

point_in_time_rule: Each row must contain only data observable before that month's strategy decision date. Label columns may use future data and must be used only for evaluation, never as input features.
